raw_segments.text: Mrs. Pocket acted on the advice and inexpertly danced the infant a little in her lap, while
the other children played about it.
This had lasted but a very short time, when Mrs. Pocket issued summary orders that they
were all to be taken into the house for a nap.
Thus, I made the second discovery on that first occasion, that the nurture of the little
pockets consisted of alternately tumbling up and lying down.
